fields.label: Penalty Points
fields.description: Points subtracted from the score when this red flag is found.

fields.label: Threshold
fields.description: Job Hopping: average years per job below this (default 1.5). No Impact: fewer measurable achievements than this (default 1). Grammar: typo ratio in % above this (default 3). Brevity: more pages than this (default 3).

fields.label: Max Words
fields.description: Brevity only: more words than this also triggers (default 1000).
